subject: M010:start
rationale: M010 Docker setup applied the Bouncy Castle migration to both endpoints. The START repair must reverse the security POM and its dependency-management BOM as one atomic Maven change, while preserving the runnable-only dubbo-test-check dependency and removing an unrelated whitespace drift. The resulting START-to-END edge is exactly the two-file 6939e3c migration to jdk18on 1.81 and remains Maven-model complete.
